courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 抽蓄水庫水位調度
related.transfer: 可遷移「彈性波速與管壁」與「沿程摩擦與耗散」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；抽蓄水庫水位調度的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall" and "Distributed friction and dissipation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分開快速彈性壓力波與慢速調壓井振盪並檢查相互作用；抽蓄水庫水位調度則以以雙庫水量與能量守恆建立可追溯的抽蓄水位排程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish rapid elastic pressure waves from slower surge-shaft oscillations and check their interaction; Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage centres on build traceable pumped-storage schedules using paired-reservoir water and energy balances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性波速與管壁」與「雙庫水量帳本」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到抽蓄水庫水位調度，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可用水量與時數」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” and “Paired reservoir water balance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Usable volume and duration", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 壓力鋼管錨定與支承
related.transfer: 可遷移「彈性波速與管壁」與「沿程摩擦與耗散」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；壓力鋼管錨定與支承的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall" and "Distributed friction and dissipation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Penstock anchorage and supports must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分開快速彈性壓力波與慢速調壓井振盪並檢查相互作用；壓力鋼管錨定與支承則以追蹤壓力、重量與溫度荷載如何經鋼管傳到錨塊支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish rapid elastic pressure waves from slower surge-shaft oscillations and check their interaction; Penstock anchorage and supports centres on trace pressure, gravity and thermal loads through penstocks into anchors and supports, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性波速與管壁」與「環向薄膜應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到壓力鋼管錨定與支承，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「跨距與梁式反力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” and “Circumferential membrane stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Penstock anchorage and supports, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Span and beam reactions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 調壓井水錘控制
history.text: 調壓設施的作用是改變長引水路的動量交換與壓力邊界，並非讓水錘從此消失。埃克盧特納官方歷史記錄調壓井於一九五三年開挖、一九五四年襯砌，提供真實井式設施的背景。科切拉配水管網則出現在墾務局一九五四年的湧浪控制專論，其灌溉配水邊界不應直接等同水力機組。工兵團二〇〇八年更新的水力電廠結構手冊提供另一方法入口。本課把各文件年代保留為出版或施工事實，所有管長、流速、井面積和壓力則另設為教學算例。
history.textEn: Surge facilities change momentum exchange and pressure boundaries in long waterways rather than eliminating every transient. Eklutna’s official history records shaft excavation in1953 and lining in1954 as a genuine shaft context. The Coachella distribution network appears in Reclamation’s1954 surge-control monograph, but irrigation boundaries are not equated with turbine behavior. USACE’s2008 hydroelectric structural update provides another methodological entry point. Dates remain publication or construction facts; conduit length, velocity, shaft area and pressure are separately specified as synthetic teaching inputs throughout the lesson.
